description: Fraction of all historical projects where this competitor submitted a bid
formula: COUNT(bids WHERE competitor = c) / COUNT(DISTINCT projects in history)

description: Ratio of asphalt tons won year-to-date vs. competitor's historical average annual tonnage; estimates how much capacity is already committed
formula: ytd_won_tons / avg_annual_won_tons; 0 if no bid_year data or no prior wins

description: Days since this competitor's most recent bid (9999 if no history)
formula: project_bid_date - MAX(bid_date WHERE competitor = c); 9999 if no history

description: Prior bids in the same state as this project
formula: COUNT(bids WHERE competitor = c AND state = project_state)

description: Prior bids in the same county as this project
formula: COUNT(bids WHERE competitor = c AND county = project_county)

description: Prior bids in the same state AND on the same project_type as this project
formula: COUNT(bids WHERE competitor = c AND state = project_state AND project_type = this_project_type)

description: Binary: competitor has at least one prior same-state bid on this project_type (0/1)
Competitor has a prior bid with real mix (asphalt) tonnage AND this project has mix tonnage in scope (0/1)
Competitor has a prior bid with real grading yardage AND this project has grading yardage in scope (0/1)
Competitor has a prior bid with real base tonnage AND this project has base tonnage in scope (0/1)
Competitor has a prior bid with real shoulder tonnage AND this project has shoulder tonnage in scope (0/1)
Competitor has a prior bid with real milling square yardage AND this project has milling in scope (0/1)
Competitor has a prior bid with real crushing tonnage AND this project has crushing in scope (0/1)
Competitor has a prior bid with real stockpile tonnage AND this project has stockpile tonnage in scope (0/1)
Log-transformed HMA/asphalt tonnage for this project (log1p scale)
Log-transformed grading cubic yards for this project (log1p scale)
Log-transformed base aggregate tonnage for this project (log1p scale)
Log-transformed shoulder aggregate tonnage for this project (log1p scale)
Log-transformed milling square yards for this project (log1p scale)
Log-transformed crushed aggregate tonnage for this project (log1p scale)
Log-transformed stockpile tonnage for this project (log1p scale)
Average of log1p(quantity) across whichever of the 7 bid-schedule quantities are actually present (nonzero) for this project
formula: mean(log1p(q) for q in [mix_tons, grading_yards, base_tons, shldr_tons, mill_sy, crush_tons, stock_tons] if q > 0); 0 if none present

description: Flag: this project is in Minnesota, where pit location data exists (0/1). All other pit_* features below are zeroed out for non-MN projects since there's no pit coverage to compute them from.
formula: 1 if project_state == 'MN' else 0 (and all pit_* features zeroed when 0)

description: Flag: project has no geocoordinates so all pit distances are unknown (0/1)
Distance in miles to the nearest publicly open pit (9999 if no project coordinates)
formula: MIN(haversine_miles(project_loc; pit_loc) for pit in open_pits); 9999 if no coordinates

description: Count of publicly open pits less than 10 miles from this project (non-overlapping band)
Count of publicly open pits 10-25 miles from this project (non-overlapping band)
Count of publicly open pits 25-50 miles from this project (non-overlapping band)
Highest quality rating among open pits within 25 miles
formula: MAX(pit.Rating for pit in open_pits WHERE distance <= 25 miles)

description: Average quality rating among open pits within 25 miles
formula: MEAN(pit.Rating for pit in open_pits WHERE distance <= 25 miles)

description: Distance in miles to the nearest pit with unknown access status (9999 if no coordinates)
formula: MIN(haversine_miles(project_loc; pit_loc) for pit in unknown_access_pits); 9999 if no coordinates

description: Count of pits with unknown access status within 25 miles

Distance in miles to this competitor's nearest owned/restricted pit (9999 if none). For Knife River divisions, also draws on the shared pool of pits marked 'pending' in the pit list (not assigned to a specific division there), since all divisions can use them.
formula: MIN(haversine_miles(project_loc; pit_loc) for pit in competitor_owned_pits [+ shared knife_river_pending pits if competitor is a Knife River division]); 9999 if none

description: Count of this competitor's owned/restricted pits within 25 miles (includes the shared Knife River pending pool for Knife River divisions)
formula: COUNT(competitor_owned_pits [+ shared knife_river_pending pits if Knife River division] WHERE distance <= 25 miles)

description: Highest quality rating among this competitor's owned/restricted pits within 25 miles
formula: MAX(pit.Rating for pit in competitor_owned_pits WHERE distance <= 25 miles)

description: Flag: this competitor has an owned/restricted pit within 25 miles (0/1)
Nearest open pit distance minus competitor's nearest owned pit distance (positive = competitor has a closer pit than the open market)
